newsitem.title: USA: ICN to buy stake in Hungarian company.
newsitem.headline: ICN to buy stake in Hungarian company.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc said it signed a definitive agreement to buy a majority stake in the Hungarian pharmaceutical company, Alkaloida Chemical Co Ltd.

ICN said its initial stake will be 50.02 percent, but will increase over the next several months to 60 percent. ICN won the right to buy the majority stake and privatize the company in a competitive bidding sponsored by the Hungarian government in June. The Hungarian government will retain a 25 percent stake in the company.

Alkaloida, which is based in northeast Hungary, makes and distributes pharmaceutical finished products and raw materials, and also works to develop new drug treatments. The company has annual sales of $66 million.
